Start here, Dad — how to use your app

On your Android: open this link in Chrome. No account or payment setup is needed.

  1. Tap SCAN TICKET. Choose Allow when Chrome asks to use the camera.
  2. Show one ticket’s product barcode. It is usually on the back. If the name or price is missing, show the printed game details and tap Read game & price. You can also choose a photo.
  3. Open My tickets. The purchase saves automatically. Check its price, quantity and purchase date.
Scratch-offs: check winnings officially

This app records the ticket and its price. To learn whether it won, scan it in the official Ohio Lottery app or ask a retailer.

Get the official Ohio Lottery app ↗
Draw games: review, then compare

In My tickets, tap Review numbers & dates. Check every play against the original, then tap Save reviewed details & check. A potential result still needs official ticket validation.

Add to home screen is optional. Keep your original tickets. Before changing phones or browsers, download a private backup in More → Backup & app info.

Barcode found.

Readable barcodes are added automatically. Supported game barcodes fill the published price; other tickets are marked Price needed.

Photos are saved encrypted in this browser for your ticket collection. Images, raw codes and played numbers are never uploaded. A private scan fingerprint helps prevent duplicates. Published-number comparisons are potential results, not official ticket validation.

What to do next

01
Show one ticket

Start with its product barcode. If it is not recognized, show the printed game number on the back or the game name and price, then tap Read game & price.

02
Find it in My tickets

A recognized scratch-off fills its name and official unit price. Draw tickets need a readable game name and explicit total cost. No name or price typing is needed for a confident match; unclear reads ask for a clearer photo.

03
Check whether it won

Scratch-off: use the official Ohio Lottery app or a retailer. Draw ticket: open My tickets, tap Review numbers & dates, then save and check. Potential results still need official ticket validation.

Already have a ticket photo?

Use a sharp photo of one ticket with the printed game number, or its name and price, visible. For draw tickets, include the game name and total cost.

Enter a barcode or reference manually

Only documented product matches fill a price. The raw code is cleared and never saved; other codes need printed details.

YOUR RECORDS BELONG TO YOU

Backup & app info

Keep your records when you change devices.

Take it with you

A full copy of your app records.

Tickets, numbers, stores, game notes, and settings stay in this browser. Download a backup before clearing browser data or switching devices.

Photo backups contain readable images. Keep the downloaded file private. Photos stay encrypted in this browser.

Restore your records

A valid JSON backup replaces your current records after confirmation. Export first if you want to keep this device’s data. CSV cannot be restored here.

Your backup is not encrypted. Keep it private. Do not enter raw barcodes, claim codes, bank details, passwords, or identity documents in notes.

Made for Joe.

A personal companion for your tickets and numbers. Barcode scanning reads a code locally. Photos can be saved encrypted in this browser; scan dates, reviewed plays and potential comparisons stay with your records. Exact published game UPCs, recognized printed game details and your confirmed remembered choices can fill the game and price. The text reader covers every game in the current scratch-off reference when its identifying details are legible; draw tickets require an explicit total cost. Readable barcodes add one ticket automatically. Other barcodes create a Price needed entry. Choose the printed scratch-off game to fill its price, and optionally remember an unrecognized product barcode for next time on this device. Official prize checks still use the original ticket.

Your records stay on this device. Nearby stores and published winner stories refresh online. This app has no ticket purchasing or official prize validation. Confirm game information and prizes with Ohio Lottery.
